name: Amazon Web Services
label: AWS
headline: Connect AWS risk to the full picture.
description: Relate AWS accounts, IAM roles, and resource configuration to the workloads and sensitive assets around them.

features.title: Resource context
features.description: Bring account, region, workload, and resource relationships into a shared environment map.

features.title: IAM access paths
features.description: Connect role trust relationships and policy scope to the resources a principal could reach.

features.title: Accountable changes
features.description: Attach the account, resource, evidence, and owner to an engineering review.

steps: Review and verify the next step
faq: Is this a working connector?
The Amazon Web Services integration is a fictional product concept. This portfolio site does not connect to accounts, collect credentials, create tickets, or apply changes.
What would a production connection require?

A production integration would need documented permissions, data handling, supported objects, refresh behavior, operational limits, and failure handling. These controls have not been implemented by this demo.
boundary: This proposed Amazon Web Services connection illustrates how context could flow through Tracegate. Coverage, permission scopes, and refresh behavior would need validation before a real deployment.
